question: The word "mitigating" in the passage means:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Making less severe.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"mitigating"** means:

 
 
• Making something less severe, serious, or painful. (किसी चीज़ को कम गंभीर, गंभीर या दर्दनाक बनाना; कम करना)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The government took measures aimed at mitigating the economic impact of the pandemic.
 
• **"Correct answer"** means:
 
 
• Referring to the specific answer that properly defines or fits the context of the question. (सही उत्तर)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The correct answer to the quiz question assured him a perfect score.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Making less severe**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Worsening** (बिगाड़ना): Making something worse.

 
 
• **Example:** His actions ended up worsening the situation.
 
 
 
• **Preventing completely** (पूरी तरह से रोकना): Stopping something from happening entirely.
 
 
• **Example:** Vaccination is key to preventing the spread of the disease completely.
 
 
 
• **Ignoring** (अनदेखा करना): Refusing to take notice of or acknowledge.
 
 
• **Example:** She kept ignoring his calls.
 
 

45:T10fd,
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.
